identity_note: Matched Nuvocargo (nuvocargo.com), the US-Mexico cross-border freight brokerage, customs and AI logistics platform founded by Deepak Chhugani. Website, sector and the QED-led Series B match the batch entry; no name collision found.

profile.name: Nuvocargo
profile.description: AI-enabled North American logistics platform that provides US-Mexico cross-border and domestic US freight brokerage, managed transportation and customs clearance for manufacturers and retailers.
profile.location: New York, NY (US); offices also in Mexico City and Laredo, TX
profile.funding_detail: More than $75M raised (Orrick, 2023); StockAnalysis lists $74.3M total. Latest priced round: $36.5M Series B (June 2023) led by QED Investors at a valuation above $250M, with Tresalia Capital and Amador Holdings new and Tiger Global, NFX, ALLVP, Magma Partners, MAYA Capital and One Way Ventures returning. Earlier: $20.5M led by Tiger Global (Dec 2021) and a $12M QED-led Series A.
profile.past_completed_deals: Merge Transportation (Charleston, SC intra-US 3PL, ~14 staff; Apr 2025, Nuvocargo's first acquisition and described as the first chapter of an AI-enabled roll-up strategy); Mentum (San Francisco YC-backed AI agent startup; Oct 2025, team folded into NuvoOS R&D).
profile.open_role: No corp-dev roles; hiring Head of Customs Brokerage, Brokerage Sales Executive, Sales Executive (3 open roles) as of 2026-10-08

verdict.headline: Stated AI roll-up · 2 deals, none since Oct 2025
verdict.detail: Called Merge the first chapter of an AI-enabled roll-up, but no deal in ~12 months and no corp-dev hire; CEO Deepak Chhugani and VP Growth & BD Claudio González are the path in.

caveats: Blog dates: Nuvocargo's blog shows 2026 dates on old posts (Series B letter dated Apr 23, 2026); trade press dates the Series B to June 2023 and Merge to Apr 23, 2025.
Headlines: latest dated news is the Nuvo AI launch on Mar 17, 2026, just outside the 6-month window; nothing newer found.
Funding total: prior pass cited 'over $85M'; today only $74.3M (StockAnalysis) and 'more than $75M' (Orrick, 2023) were confirmed.
Headcount: Tracxn says 72 (May 2026), Startup Intros ~150 (July 2026); LinkedIn not checked directly.
HQ: About page lists New York, Mexico City and Laredo offices without naming an HQ; New York used as the US base.
People: titles from the About page, which shows two leadership lists that don't fully match (Jim Keating appears only in one; González only in the other).
Careers read: careers.nuvocargo.com is a JS app; roles read from its public jobs feed (/api/v1/careers/jobs), all 3 posted May-June 2026.
